clues.text: After ten years in Canaan, Abram's childless wife gave him her Egyptian maidservant to be his wife.
Once she knew she was pregnant by Abram, this servant began to despise her mistress.
Fleeing harsh treatment, she was found by the angel of the LORD at a desert spring on the road to Shur.
After an angel spoke to her by a spring, she called the LORD "the God who sees me."
Early one morning Abraham put bread and a skin of water on her shoulders and sent her away with a boy.
In the Wilderness of Beersheba, she sat a bowshot away from her boy and wept as their water ran out.
Paul wrote that this slave woman stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and the present-day Jerusalem.
